sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Nilesh Manore - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Madhusudan Yadav - G.A. for the State.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

2. This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.) as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.78/2025 registered at Police Station Kotwali Jhabua, District Jhabua (MP) for offence punishable under Section 376(3), 376(2)(n), 306, 376(2)(f) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6, 5(j)/ii/6 and 5(n) of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 01/02/2025.
3. Allegation against the applicant is of rape.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Having considered the rival submissions and perusal of the case diary, looking to the fact that the prosecutrix also got pregnant due to the rape, no case for grant of bail is made out.
6.
